title: AARO Moves to Contract Access to Nation's Largest Private UFO Records Archive
detail: The Pentagon's All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office issued a sole-source contract notice seeking a one-year subscription (with four optional one-year extensions) to the National UFO Historical Records Center (NUFOHRC), a New Mexico-based nonprofit founded by UAP historian David Marler that holds North America's largest private collection of UAP case files — including the complete archives of early civilian scientific UFO research groups and the personal files of Dr. J. Allen Hynek from Project Blue Book. The notice specifically targets pre-1990 material, citing AARO's congressional mandate (FY2023 NDAA) to review US government UAP involvement back to 1945. A War Department official said market research found 'no other organization possesses the historical depth, volume of unique records, and specialized analytical expertise to meet the government's minimum needs.' The Pentagon declined to disclose estimated contract costs.
confidenceReason: Reported directly from a federal contracting notice (public record) by a specialized defense trade outlet with a named War Department official quote; single-source pending wider pickup.
